steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each assumption and change is matched to its source and its reason.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Assumption with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the assumption

findings.title: Change with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason for the change

findings.title: Forecast total does not follow from the assumptions

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] assume-cost.md:12  Assumption with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the assumption.
[medium] change-2.md:19  Change with no reason.
       Fix: Give the reason for the change.
[low] forecast-total.csv:26  Forecast total does not follow from the assumptions.
       Fix: Recompute the total.
Not checked: Whether the assumptions will hold.
pros: Checks an assumption with no source, a change with no reason, and a forecast total that does not follow from the assumptions.
cons: Not checked: Whether the assumptions will hold.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-rolling-forecast skill on the records for this review.
